episodes.synopsis: Instead of finding textbooks to study with, Miaka Yuki finds an old book which turns out to be rather absorbing--literally.
episodes.title: The Girl of Legend

episodes.synopsis: An encounter with the Emperor of Konan leads to Miaka discovering her purpose and her destiny in this new world.
episodes.title: The Priestess of Suzaku

episodes.synopsis: Miaka must find the seven Celestial Warriors, and she already has two. The third soon reveals himself, but it's not a joyous occasion.
episodes.title: The Seven Stars of Suzaku

episodes.synopsis: Miaka comes to understand Nuriko's true feelings, and in assisting him, learns Hotohori's true feelings as well. But Tamahome's true feelings are still elusive.
episodes.title: Missing Love

episodes.synopsis: In order to return her to her own world, the Celestial Warriors accompany Miaka to a mountain where Taiitsukun, a being said to control the universe, is said to reside.
episodes.title: Bewildered Heartbeat

episodes.synopsis: Trapped in a mirror, Miaka faces herself in an all too literal way. When her shadow steps from the mirror to torment her friends, Miaka must make a difficult choice.
episodes.title: Even If I Die

episodes.synopsis: Taiitsukun reveals herself to Miaka and the others, and reveals the way to return Miaka to her home. However, not everything goes as planned.
episodes.title: Going Home

episodes.synopsis: Miaka returns home, only to find herself restless. She struggles with deciding where she belongs. And Yui seems to have disappeared... but where to?
episodes.title: Brief Parting

episodes.synopsis: Back in the world of the book, Miaka visits the home of Tamahome. However, Miaka soon learns that things have changed, as an assassin from another country targets her.
episodes.title: Enemies Unseen

episodes.synopsis: Troubled by advice from Chichiri, and in search of the missing Yui, Miaka travels to Kuto alone, leaving Tamahome with an aching heart.
episodes.title: Looking for Yui

episodes.synopsis: Miaka is the Priestess of Suzaku, and it turns out that Yui is the Priestess of Seiryu. So much has changed, but the two are still friends... right?
episodes.title: Priestess of Seiryuu

episodes.synopsis: Though distraught over Yui's pain and rage, Miaka commits herself once again to assembling the Suzaku Seven... and to Tamahome.
episodes.title: Only You

episodes.synopsis: Tamahome gives himself to the Kuto Empire in order to buy Miaka time to find the other Suzaku Seven. Miaka's search doesn't go smoothly, however.
episodes.title: For the Sake of Love

episodes.synopsis: Miaka searches for the fifth of the Celestial Warriors among bandits, but ends up being taken hostage by a strange man with a wolf-like appearance.
episodes.title: Wolf in the Fortress

episodes.synopsis: It seems that Tasuki, the fifth Celestial Warrior, is dead. Miaka pursues a rumor about someone with the ability to resurrect the dead, but falls gravely ill.
episodes.title: The City of Resurrection

episodes.synopsis: Miaka must die in order for the healer Shoka's powers of revival to work. Hotohori makes one last plea to a reclusive doctor, where he learns the truth about Shoka.
episodes.title: Battle of Sorrow

episodes.synopsis: After days of fruitless searching, an attempt on Miaka's life reveals the seventh of the Suzaku Seven, the flute-playing Chiriko.
episodes.title: Magic Flute

episodes.synopsis: With the help of Chichiri's powers, Miaka and Tamahome make a promise to meet so they may be reunited. Yui refuses to let Tamahome go.
episodes.title: Love Trap

episodes.synopsis: Miaka escapes from prison following Yui's ambush, and searches for Tamahome. Unfortunately, when she finds him, she'll almost wish she hadn't.
episodes.title: Shattered Love

episodes.synopsis: Tamahome is not the same Tamahome that Miaka knows and loves any more. With her heart torn apart, Miaka must say goodbye, and leave him with Yui and the Kuto Empire.
episodes.title: Unreachable Hope

episodes.synopsis: Hotohori attempts to comfort Miaka as she struggles with her broken heart, desperate to forget about her love. But Tamahome won't be forgotten so easily.
episodes.title: To Protect You

episodes.synopsis: Tamahome and Hotohori clash, fighting to the death. But the love between Tamahome and Miaka creates a miracle, making possible the impossible.
episodes.title: I'll Never Leave You

episodes.synopsis: With Tamahome finally back to normal, all of the Konan Empire begin the preparations to summon Suzaku. However, they remain completely ignorant of Nakago's trap.
episodes.title: Shadow of Intrigue

episodes.synopsis: The Celestial Warriors and the Priestess begin the ceremony to summon Suzaku. But then, Nakago's cunning plans to disrupt the ceremony are revealed.
episodes.title: Resolution

episodes.synopsis: Taiitsukun shows up to reveal that not all is lost, and there still remains a method to summon Suzaku. However, what she tells to Miaka in private will change everything for her.
episodes.title: Love and Sorrow

episodes.synopsis: Miaka and the Suzaku Seven prepare for their trip to Hokkan, the land of Genbu. Before they go, Tamahome visits home again, but finds only pain.
episodes.title: Star Festival

episodes.synopsis: Suboshi, the twin of Amiboshi, wants revenge for the death of his brother. Horrified by the fate of Tamahome's family, Miaka resolves to fight against Seiryu.
episodes.title: Tombstone Oath

episodes.synopsis: As Miaka and the Suzaku Seven travel to Hokkan, the story pauses to reflect on the events that lead up to this point.
episodes.title: The Ancient Path

episodes.synopsis: Back on Earth, Miaka's brother Keisuke researches the origins of the Universe of the Four Gods, and discovers something startling. He communicates with Miaka, who must make a choice.
episodes.title: Mysteries Afoot

episodes.synopsis: A sudden attack on the ship leaves Miaka, Nuriko, and Tamahome trapped in a cave. When they rejoin the others, the Seiryu warrior Soi confronts them, but Miaka repels the attack. Finally landing in Hokkan, the group learns about the Shinzaho.
episodes.title: The Flash of Battle

episodes.synopsis: Miaka and the Warriors search for the Shinzaho in the city of Touran, and Tamahome may have the answer. Meanwhile, Miaka struggles with whether she should return home, or keep her love.
episodes.title: Whirlpool of Doubt

episodes.synopsis: Nuriko fights off the bestial Ashitare, and at the same time, Tamahome confronts Yui. After, Nuriko consoles Tamahome on his doubt, while Nuriko affirms who he really is.
episodes.title: To Die for the Star of Suzaku

episodes.synopsis: Nuriko opens the door to the Shinzaho, but not without a cost. A happy occasion is tainted by a grief too powerful to bear.
episodes.title: Nuriko, Eternal Farewell

episodes.synopsis: Within the cave of the Shinzaho, the Suzaku Warriors are confronted by a pair of two hundred year old ghosts of the Genbu Warriors. Miaka must prove herself worthy of the Shinzaho.
episodes.title: Guardians of Ice

episodes.synopsis: The Shinzaho is stolen from Miaka by someone once thought dead. Miaka's guilt prompts her to take responsibility in a somewhat unusual manner.
episodes.title: Hell's Mirage

episodes.synopsis: Acting on a bad feeling, Tamahome races to find Miaka. He instead finds Nakago, who gloats about what he has taken from the Priestess of Suzaku.
episodes.title: Trampled Love

episodes.synopsis: Tamahome's kindness is too much for Miaka to bear after her encounter with Nakago. She runs away from him and her life, and then encounters a familiar face.
episodes.title: Bewitched Warmth

episodes.synopsis: Carrying pain in their hearts, Miaka is tempted to forget everything, while Tamahome is tempted to abandon hope for himself.
episodes.title: Dawn of the Heart

episodes.synopsis: Reunited again, Miaka and Tamahome have but a moment to embrace before the illusionist Tomo of the Seiryu Warriors attacks. Miaka is trapped in a dream, but it's far from a nightmare.
episodes.title: Bewitched Illusions

episodes.synopsis: Caught in Tomo's fantasy world, Miaka is shown a world of love, kindness, and happy things. Will Miaka surrender to this pleasant dream, or will she remember what she truly loves?
episodes.title: Deceptive Love

episodes.synopsis: After defeating Tomo, Miaka and the Suzaku Warriors recover in Sairo. But rather than relaxing, Tamahome begins to distance himself from Miaka, driving a new wedge between them.
episodes.title: Sunlight of Rebirth

episodes.synopsis: It seems the love Tamahome and Miaka have for one another is destined to end. However, while the two chase after one another, the Seiryu Warriors move to take the second Shinzaho.
episodes.title: Unbreachable Wall

episodes.synopsis: Tatara of the Byakko Seven reveals not only the second Shinzaho, but the truth about what becomes of love between Warrior and Priestess.
episodes.title: Farewell Reunion

episodes.synopsis: Chiriko has been possessed by the evil Miboshi, and the Suzaku Seven must fight one of their own. Meanwhile, Yui prepares to summon Seiryu.
episodes.title: Moment of Battle

episodes.synopsis: Yui summons Seiryu and then makes her first wish. In the aftermath, everything changes, both in love, and in war.
episodes.title: Divergent Light

episodes.synopsis: Although Yui wanted to separate Miaka from Tamahome by returning to Earth, somehow Tamahome has come through as well. Meanwhile, the situation worsens back in Konan.
episodes.title: The Young Man of Reality

episodes.synopsis: The real world is no place for a character in a book, and Tamahome searches for the meaning of his existence. Meanwhile, in Konan, Mitsukake knows exactly what his purpose is.
episodes.title: Repose of the Soul's Light

episodes.synopsis: After being saved from Suboshi by Tamahome in the real world, Miaka is able to speak with Hotohori, one last time.
episodes.title: Even Wagering on This Life

episodes.synopsis: Miaka is finally able to tell Yui about Nakago's treachery, just in time for Nakago to appear in their own world.
episodes.title: Wedding Celebration

episodes.synopsis: Nakago stands before Tamahome and Miaka on Earth. Tamahome struggles valiantly, while Yui struggles with her own inner doubt.
episodes.title: Atonement

episodes.synopsis: With the seal broken, Miaka makes use of Yui's sacrifice to summon the beast-god Suzaku, and uses its power against Nakago.
episodes.title: Entrusted Hope

episodes.synopsis: The Suzaku Seven reunite with the Priestess. The final battle begins against Nakago. Will this story have a happy ending?
episodes.title: For My Loved One
